task_path=progdir/'task-9794161b.py'
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    separators_r = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == 3 for v in grid[r])]
    separators_c = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 3 for r in range(h))]
    nonsep = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if r not in separators_r and c not in separators_c]
    background = Counter(nonsep).most_common(1)[0][0]
    def spans(size, separators):
        out, start = [], 0
        for s in separators:
            if start < s:
                out.append((start, s))
            start = s + 1
        if start < size:
            out.append((start, size))
        return out
    rs, cs = spans(h, separators_r), spans(w, separators_c)
    blocks = [(r0, r1, c0, c1) for r0, r1 in rs for c0, c1 in cs]
    def marks(block):
        r0, r1, c0, c1 = block
        return [(r-r0, c-c0, grid[r][c]) for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1) if grid[r][c] != background]
    source = max(blocks, key=lambda b: len(marks(b)))
    pattern = marks(source)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0, r1, c0, c1 in blocks:
        for dr, dc, color in pattern:
            if r0 + dr < r1 and c0 + dc < c1:
                out[r0 + dr][c0 + dc] = color
    return out
'''
